blockers.title: L7 is not terminal in the sense claimed: three genuine layer breaks are either silent or are caught only by a published counter that ordinary maintenance republishes
blockers.statement: The candidate states that L7 'breaks L2, L3, L4 and L5 in copies of this file's own syntax tree ... and requires each to be detected BY ITS NAMED FINDING'. I broke the same layers with mutations the author's finite set does not contain. Three results falsify the claim's force: one break is wholly silent, and two are caught ONLY by a C2V5-CENSUS drift on a self-published counter — i.e. by the self-binding of claim 6, not by the layer that was broken. Since the self-binding's whole cost model is that the counter is republished whenever the checker's shape changes, republishing it is the ordinary maintenance action, and doing so converts each of these from caught to silent. I verified that conversion, I did not assume it.
evidence: _adjudicated_census_lines -> 'return set()' : 0 findings, full green. This single break simultaneously voids the C2V5-SCAN-BLIND anchor at line 1162-1169 (`unseen` becomes empty) and the C2V5-REPRO enumeration check at line 1814-1818 (`set() <= anything` is True). The checker's own words are 'a scan that cannot see the defect it exists to catch is decorative'; this makes that test unable to see that it cannot see. Nothing in L7 breaks it.

locked_integer_leaves -> base-direction only (drop the effective document from the union) : caught, but SOLELY by C2V5-CENSUS 'documentIntegerLeavesTypeLocked is published as 137 but this run measured 136'. Republishing the three affected counters 137->136 alongside the break yields 0 findings and a full green run. L2b's bidirectionality — the property that stops the derivation from introducing an unlocked integer leaf — is therefore guarded by a number, not by a layer.

same_json_type -> boolean-counts-as-number conflation : caught, but SOLELY by C2V5-CENSUS 'behaviouralExecutedCases is published as 384 but this run measured 368'. No C2V5-BEHAVIOUR, no C2V5-TYPE, no C2V5-DOCLOCK.

Contrast, to show the suite is not generally weak: is_wire_int, wire_int_equal, _gate_dominates, _provably_non_numeric, _function_universe, document_type_findings and document_type_probe breaks are all caught, and four of them by the layer they break (C2V5-BEHAVIOUR, C2V5-SCAN, C2V5-SCAN-BLIND, C2V5-DOCLOCK). The failure is specific and enumerable, not diffuse.

nonBlockingObservations.title: The claim that every selftest assertion is on a finding id AND on the position under test is overstated for 25 of 38 rows
nonBlockingObservations.detail: Row census: 4 parsed-JSON-root + 14 contract + 8 source + 3 scan + 6 differential + 3 document-differential = 38. The 14 contract and 8 source rows assert `any(f.startswith(expected + ':'))` — a finding id, but not the position. The 4 root rows assert on findings[0] only, an ordering dependency. The 3 SCAN_MUTATIONS rows carry no expected id at all: SCAN_MUTATIONS is a list of 2-tuples and the assertion is `broken > clean` on a scan count. The 9 differential rows assert successorNamedThePosition, which is position-named but not id-named. Only L5's internal probe enforces both. theDefect.minimalReproduction.theTrap states without scope: 'Every assertion in check-c2-v5.py is on a specific finding id AND on the finding naming the position under test, never on an exit code.' The corresponding SOURCE comment at line 1197 is scoped to L5 by the word 'below' and is accurate; the contract's restatement dropped the scope. In mitigation I could not construct a collateral pass: the two count-raising breaks I tried (_gate_dominates -> False, _provably_non_numeric -> False) both leave the scan at 0, so the three scan rows are not presently loose. The finding is an inaccurate claim, not a demonstrated escape.

centralClaimAdjudications.title: The self-binding maintenance cost: publishing counters derived from the checker's own shape forces republication when the checker is edited
centralClaimAdjudications.adjudication: SOUND AS A BINDING; UNSOUND AS A GUARD; AND IT DOES CREATE THE PRESSURE THE QUESTION NAMES
centralClaimAdjudications.ruling: The binding itself is well-motivated and demonstrably live. All 21 v5MeasuredCounters are measured at run time and compared through the same comparator applied to the predecessor: understating behaviouralExecutedCases to 1 produces C2V5-CENSUS, spelling registeredCensusPositions as 48.0 produces C2V5-TYPE, and 53 of the candidate's 66 integer leaves reject a float precisely because they are inside this block or inside the derivation. As an anti-drift binding it works and I would not ask for its removal. The defect is architectural, not incidental: for at least two genuine layer breaks the counter is the ONLY detector. locked_integer_leaves losing its second direction is caught by nothing except 'documentIntegerLeavesTypeLocked 137 vs 136'; same_json_type conflating boolean with number is caught by nothing except 'behaviouralExecutedCases 384 vs 368'. Republishing a counter after a checker edit is not a suspicious act — it is the exact act the binding's own cost model tells the maintainer to perform, and the candidate calls it 'deliberate binding'. I verified that performing it silences the first break completely: base-only lock plus 137->136 across the three affected counters yields zero findings and a full green run. So the binding converts a semantic guard into a numeric one and then hands the maintainer the instruction to overwrite the number. That is not merely a pressure toward the v4 habit; it is a mechanism that rewards it. The repair is not to unbind, but to ensure no counter is the sole detector of any layer break: bind the counters AND keep an independent layer-level assertion behind each.
centralClaimAdjudications.secondOrderPoint: The self-binding also makes ordinary maintenance expensive in a way that will be paid in exactly the wrong currency. scanSelfFunctionLikeNodes=99 means adding one helper function to check-c2-v5.py forces a contract republication. The cheapest way to satisfy that is to run the checker, read the number out of the finding text, and paste it back. That is a mechanical republication loop with no re-derivation step anywhere in it, and it is precisely how a published counter stops meaning anything. RES-C2V5-05 names the analogous trust relationship for the measurement functions; this one is not named anywhere in the candidate and should be.

centralClaimAdjudications.measuredAtRuntime: All 21 v5MeasuredCounters are computed live in _measured_block_findings from authority.behavioural, authority.scan_self, authority.scan_predecessor, authority.differential, authority.document_lock and len(measured_positions(...)), then compared through wire_int_equal in both directions with an unknown-key check. I confirmed by drift and by type substitution at every one of the 21: all 21 reject a float with C2V5-TYPE and all reject an understatement with C2V5-CENSUS. The register position set is derived from the live measurement and required to equal the declared register in both directions; hand-listing it produces C2V5-REGISTER. The 48 census positions, the 137 locked leaves, the 384 behavioural cases, the 99/162 function-like node counts and the 69/68 predecessor scan figures are all measured, not declared. This is a real improvement on the failure mode the freeze records.
